author: Stan Horwitz
text: That’s a question you would do well to discuss with Abbott customer support. You might be right about the glue formulation changing, but what about the soap you use? Could the soap you use changed formation in a way that causes this problem by triggering a different reaction from the sensor glue?

author: Christie Moore
text: After you clean the area with alcohol spray the area with Flonase and let dry before you apply the sensor. I had issues with reactions. Since using the flonase no more reactions.
